spec.name: Trend v25
spec.notes: Built for calm markets: the signal works in calm regimes and gives back part of it in stressed ones. Intended to run at reduced size when volatility is high.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.4, annual return 8%, maximum drawdown 11%.

exhibits.summary: On the sealed period, traded as live (strict data, 10 bps, at least one bar of lag), the Sharpe ratio is 2.94 against 1.43 in research, a gap of -1.50.
The log holds 5 distinct specs; the best of 5 under no edge is expected to reach a Sharpe of 0.13, so the claimed 1.40 becomes 1.27 and the probability that the true Sharpe is above zero is 100%.
The real signal's gross Sharpe of 1.59 beats 100% of 200 shuffled signals (shuffled mean 0.01, 95th percentile 0.61).
Perturbing the 2 numeric values in the signal by up to 50% moves the Sharpe ratio from 1.43 to as low as 1.20 (as low as 1.32 at 25%).
On the full universe the Sharpe ratio is 1.43 against 1.43 as submitted; the strategy never saw 0 delisted assets.
The scan (a heuristic) found no phrase addressed to reviewers or giving instructions in 2 text sources.

verdict.opinion: The strategy's Sharpe ratio in the sealed period (2.94) is significantly higher than in the research period (1.43), suggesting potential lookahead bias. This discrepancy indicates the strategy may not perform as claimed in live trading, warranting rejection.
